acquisition method: The MS method used in this study was a data-dependent acquisition (DDA) with 3 s duty cycle.
alkylation reagent: followed by alkylation for another 30 min at room temperature with 0.1 mL of 162 mM iodoacetamide; 7 mg of protein were incubated with 343 µM Maleimide-PEG2-biotin
alkylation concentration: followed by alkylation for another 30 min at room temperature with 0.1 mL of 162 mM iodoacetamide; 7 mg of protein were incubated with 343 µM Maleimide-PEG2-biotin
cleavage agent: followed by incubating with trypsin (Promega, #V5111) (ratio of 1:50 W/W) overnight at 37 °C.
collision energy: as many MS/MS scans as possible at collision energy 38 in a 3 s duty cycle
enrichment method: The isolation and detection of persulfidated proteins were performed using an adaptation to the biotin thiol assay (BTA); Prior to adding the alkylated proteins to the streptavidin-agarose resin containing spin columns
fractionation method: 0.75 mm thick one-dimensional (SDS)-12% polyacrylamide gels were used to separate persulfidated proteins for in-gel digestion
fragmentation method: and collision-induced dissociation (CID) MS/MS product ion spectra with an ion-trap analyzer; using higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) as the fragmentation method for MS/MS scans.

interfaced with a ThermoFisher Scientific Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer
